name: Cancels and Normal Routes
summary: Build Nayuki's normal route, then finish a dash normal with a Special.
description: Build Nayuki's normal route, then finish a dash normal with a Special.

pages.title: Cancels
pages.text: When a normal hits or gets blocked, you can often cut its recovery short and go straight into another move - that's a cancel. A, then B, then C, then a Special or Super is the usual order, but treat it as a guide, not a law. Each move decides what it can cancel into.

pages.title: B Routes
pages.text: B routes change with character and distance. Nayuki can go {input:c.5B} into {input:2B} into {input:f.5B}, and she can skip any of them along the way. Other characters link their close 5B, 2B, and far 5B differently, so learn the route for whoever you play.

pages.title: Command and Dash Normals
pages.text: Command normals like 6B, and attacks done out of a dash like 66A, follow their own cancel routes. Many skip the ordinary normal chain and go straight to a Special, Super, IC, or jump.

tasks.label: Perform {input:5A} > {input:c.5B} > {input:f.5B} > {input:5C} > {input:236A}
tasks.prompt: Land every hit - each move has to cancel straight out of the one before it.

feedback.success: Clean! Every attack flowed as a direct cancel.
feedback.failure: Keep the route unbroken - if a move recovers or whiffs, start over from 5A.

feedback.success: Nice - all three B attacks in one string.
feedback.failure: Stay close: cancel c.5B into 2B, then 2B into f.5B.

feedback.success: That's it - the Special came straight off the dash normal.
